name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Success Manager | GoHighLevel & CRM Automation, Adoption, Account Health & Expansion
summary: Client success manager who works hands-on inside the account. I build and fix GoHighLevel workflows, pipelines, forms, calendars, and email and SMS automation myself, and I trace integration and messaging issues down to what broke and why. At Birdeye I managed 15-20 partners, including healthcare-focused agencies, and kept all but one by watching utilization and stepping in early. At Wix I onboarded 25+ clients a month at 110% of implementation targets.

experience.title: Client Success & CRM Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the client relationship for a portfolio of service businesses, auditing and adjusting workflows, pipelines, forms, calendars, and automations to match how each business actually operates.
Built a 20+ workflow GoHighLevel system: lead capture and routing, booking with confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, reactivation, and automated review requests.
Troubleshoot integrations and messaging directly, working in webhooks, REST APIs, and JSON payloads, and hold email deliverability above 99% across email and SMS programs.
Install Meta Pixel and Google Ads conversion tracking and enforce UTM conventions so lead source and ad attribution stay accurate.
Identify expansion opportunities and scope complementary services, documenting every interaction, goal, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail, including agencies focused on healthcare clients, retaining all but one (~94%).
Analyzed partner utilization to spot at-risk accounts early and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, and fed structured feedback to Product and Engineering.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 110% of implementation targets, and managed a high-value portfolio that saw 25% conversion improvement across supported accounts.
Led onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists, running weekly training and 1:1 coaching.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Advised clients on CRM adoption and guided onboarding and workflow design, building relationships with C-suite executives.
